thread:
marta_support: Escalation from AcmeCorp — their tool/function invoke is failing with a JSON schema validation error. They get a 422 and this body:

marta_support: <response from API>
```json
{
  "error": "Schema validation failed",
  "issues": [
    {
      "path": "billingProfile",
      "message": "additional property 'billingProfile' is not allowed"
    },
    {
      "path": "session",
      "message": "required property 'session' is missing"
    }
  ]
}
```

marta_support: Sent payload (redacted):
```json
{
  "tool": "invoice.create",
  "params": {
    "amount": 1200,
    "currency": "USD",
    "billingProfile": {
      "id": "bp_12345"
    }
  }
}
```

marta_support: Notes: customer upgraded our SDK from 3.1.9 -> 3.2.1 yesterday. They claim previously accepted billingProfile in params. They are blocked (paying customer).

joel_infra: pinging infra and schema owners. can you repro locally with SDK 3.2.1?

marta_support: repro steps we used:
1) curl POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tool/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d @payload.json
2) see 422 with issues array above

anya_ml: quick skim: looks like function schema (tool definition) removed additionalProperties: true for params in 3.2.1 generation path. likely strict validation now.

joel_infra: confirming — saw a change in the codegen that sets additionalProperties: false for function params when certain annotations are present. added a test failing locally reproducing same error.

kevin_oncall: severity? customer blocked — classify P1 for support ops. we need ETA for workaround in next 2 hrs or provide compatibility shim.

anya_ml: short-term workaround: ask customer to move billingProfile into top-level metadata we accept, or drop the nested object. longer-term: add compatibility flag to tool registry to accept extra props OR relax schema to allow additionalProperties.

marta_support: can we ship a hotfix to relax schema for invoice.create only?

joel_infra: we can, but needs PR + quick test + canary. I can open PR, request review from @anya_ml for schema change and @deploy-bot to run canary.

deploy-bot: canary job queued: build 2026.3.15-cfg-relax-invoice-schema -> smoke tests running. (will report back) :gear:

anya_ml: schema change LGTM if we just add "additionalProperties": true on params for that tool. must add unit to prevent regression.

kevin_oncall: please also create support ticket for the customer with workaround notes and ETA. add billing impact flag.

marta_support: ticket created: #SUP-2026-4782. I told customer temporary workaround: remove billingProfile or send it under metadata.billing_profile and we will map. they accepted temporary workaround.

joel_infra: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4823 — title: "relax invoice.create params schema to allow additionalProperties". linking ticket SUP-2026-4782.

deploy-bot: canary passed. ready to promote to stage.

joel_infra: staging deploy scheduled in 20m, prod deploy after 1h if no regressions. rolling deploy with feature flag.

anya_ml: will monitor schema validation error rate for invoice.create. I added alert: invoice.create.schema.failures (5m) -> paged to eng if >5/min.

marta_support: customer notified about ETA: prod patch ~1.5h, they said OK. closing loop once prod is live.

kevin_oncall: good. postmortem if this was caused by codegen change without backward-compat test. assign to infra and ml-codegen teams.

marta_support: will follow up after prod deploy and update SUP-2026-4782. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
